«constructor»+Transaction(transactionId: String, customer: Customer, artPieces: List<Art>, transactionDate: Date, transactionPrice: double)
All art: base 10.99. Drawing and Print: base only.
Transaction quote = sum of each art price + its shipping.}
rejects missing/completed records, and checks EVERY art ID against inventory.
Any failure leaves inventory and transaction unchanged. Prepare total/date
before mutation; perform no file I/O in the commit.
Transaction.completeTransaction() assigns its date and stored total once.
Only after successful completion does ArtManager remove all purchased art.
Validation/commit is one non-interleaved in-memory operation.}
id is exactly 10 decimal digits; yearCreated is a year; description <=500 chars.
All common and subtype values are required; no Art setters.
Subclass constructors pass inherited arguments to super.
Painting/Drawing/Print category: history, portrait, genre, landscape, still life.
Print editionType: canvas, paper, photo. Styles/techniques/materials are open text.
All four calculateShippingCost(): double operations override Art.}
UI supplies the unique transaction ID. Require Customer and >=1 Art.
transactionDate == null means incomplete. Only completion sets date/price.
After completion: no edits/removal; date/price/ID have no public setters.
Customer values are mutable, but Transaction copies customer data on input/
output and protects its completed snapshot. Art-list and Date getters copy.
The five-argument constructor restores saved state without replaying a sale.
Text-file loading preserves both incomplete and completed transactions.
Art IDs in artPieces are unique; duplicate additions fail before mutation.}
Hollow diamonds denote shared aggregation at the whole. No exclusive
part lifetime is specified, so no composition is invented.
Art/Transaction may exist before manager admission; Art survives in sales.
Each Transaction has exactly 1 Customer and at least 1 Art; either part may
Completion failures: InvalidTransactionException. Messages include operation, ID, reason.}
